lessons.title: Emergency Manoeuvres

content.text: When driving along the road, there driver may need to make sudden and unexpected manoeuvres so as to avoid accidents or any imminent danger. Emergency manoeuvres involves quick and efficient moves.

keyPoints: When driving along the road, there driver may need to make sudden and unexpected manoeuvres so as to avoid accidents or any imminent danger.

quiz.question: What is the main focus of this section on 'Emergency Manoeuvres'?
options: Understanding emergency manoeuvres concepts and safe practices

lessons.title: Safely performing evasive turns on the road

content.text: Evasive manoeuvre driving is important in getting out of situations of danger. Some of the skills that you should learn include making J-turns and U-turns. This is addressed in Unit 8.

keyPoints: Evasive manoeuvre driving is important in getting out of situations of danger.

quiz.question: What is the main focus of this section on 'Safely performing evasive turns on the road'?
options: Understanding emergency manoeuvres concepts and safe practices

lessons.title: Brake failure

items: If your brake fails, try pumping the brake pedal to temporarily restore hydraulic brake pressure. If this does not work, apply the parking brake (hand brake) gently but firmly while holding the release button.
Total brake failure is rare on modern vehicles but if your brakes fail and you manage to stop, do not drive again. Call for help from your mechanic

lessons.title: Blowouts

content.text: In order to drive through a tyre blowout:

items: Keep a firm grip on the steering wheel.
Do not slam on the brakes.
Let your car slow down gradually.
Pull to the side of the road once you have slowed to a safe speed.
Activate your hazard lights

keyPoints: In order to drive through a tyre blowout:
Keep a firm grip on the steering wheel.
Do not slam on the brakes.
Let your car slow down gradually.

options: Understanding emergency manoeuvres concepts and safe practices

lessons.title: If your wheel goes off the pavement

items: Hold the steering firmly
Take your foot off the accelerator pedal to slow down, avoid heavy braking.
When the vehicle is under control, steer towards the pavement.

keyPoints: Hold the steering firmly
Take your foot off the accelerator pedal to slow down, avoid heavy braking.
When the vehicle is under control, steer towards the pavement.

lessons.title: If your headlights go off

items: Check the switch immediately
If the lights remain off, keep to the left and bring your vehicle to a safe stop off the road.
It is dangerous and illegal to drive at night without lights

keyPoints: Check the switch immediately

lessons.title: Defensive Driving

content.text: Defensive driving is safe driving or cautious driving in cases where the driver needs to be more vigilant particularly in an environment that could cause danger. It goes beyond mastering the rules of the road and basic mechanical skills and is taught to experienced drivers.

keyPoints: Defensive driving is safe driving or cautious driving in cases where the driver needs to be more vigilant particularly in an environment that could cause danger.

quiz.question: What is the main focus of this section on 'Defensive Driving'?
options: Understanding emergency manoeuvres concepts and safe practices

lessons.title: Importance of defensive driving

items: It allows you to be prepared to avoid accidents
It allows you to provide more protection to yourself and/or passengers
It is enables you to save lives in situations of danger
It enables you to save money by limiting wear and tear to your
motor vehicle and any unexpected damage
It prepares you to act accordingly in adverse riding conditions

keyPoints: It allows you to be prepared to avoid accidents
It allows you to provide more protection to yourself and/or passengers
It is enables you to save lives in situations of danger

quiz.question: What is the main focus of this section on 'Importance of defensive driving'?
options: Understanding emergency manoeuvres concepts and safe practices

lessons.title: Defensive driving is important when in the following condition

items: Adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog or windy. In these cases, the road surface may change and so you need to apply different techniques to avoid danger
Different road conditions that may be difficult to manoeuvre such rough terrain, wet surface or sloping surfaces.

keyPoints: Adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog or windy. In these cases, the road surface may change and so you need to apply different techniques to avoid danger

lessons.title: Defensive driving techniques

items: Improving observation, anticipation and awareness consistent with the riding speed
Applying sound judgement of speed and distance
Don’t drive when you are tired, rest before any journey

keyPoints: Improving observation, anticipation and awareness consistent with the riding speed
Applying sound judgement of speed and distance
Don’t drive when you are tired, rest before any journey

quiz.question: When a tyre blows out at speed, you should first:
options: Grip the wheel firmly, steer straight, then slow gradually
Swerve to the hard shoulder immediately

quiz.question: A three-point turn is performed when:
options: You need to reverse direction in a narrow road

quiz.question: Emergency braking on a vehicle without ABS should involve:
options: Pressing the brake to the floor and holding
Threshold braking — firm pressure just before wheels lock, ease off slightly

quiz.question: A U-turn should only be performed when:
options: It is safe, legal, and you have sufficient space
Other road users signal you to do so

quiz.question: Defensive driving means:
options: Driving very slowly at all times
Anticipating and responding safely to hazards created by others
Using the horn frequently to warn others
Always driving in the left lane
